teaser: A packed bag by the door, days before the flight is even booked. A single brushstroke chosen over an hour, then left to dry. You are a life path 5, built for motion, crossed with an ISFP, built for feeling through the fingers before the head catches up. Other 5s push restlessness outward, chasing the next city or deal. In you it turns inward first, through color, texture, the shape of a room before you decide to leave it. The want for freedom and the want for honest sensation are not two different hungers here. They are the same one, worn differently.
excerpt: A paperback left open, spine cracked, at the library table where you were supposed to be working side by side.
